[RDSC.5a.7e.1] The `SeriesBackendFifoDeque` atom declares an order-preserving FIFO deque
providing sliding-window `first`, `bool_or`, and `bool_and`. `bool_*`
are tracked by an in-window true-count, so the query is O(1); `first`
reads the front. State is O(window·rate) (bounded by `max_samples`).
